receipts.gate: interpreters.validate_registrations refuses an unserved lane that is in neither population, and refuses a dated row no declaration reaches (D-92)

modules.calculator/item_coverage.py: the reviewed no-runtime-behaviour set NO_RUNTIME_BEHAVIOR, the one name-keyed container 3.8's collapse left standing here: 'we looked and there is nothing' is a fact no declaration can carry, so it is reviewed prose by construction and criterion 2 keeps it as a non-increasing ratchet rather than retiring it.  Its members are counter 2's whole population *and* the count counter 2 is bounded by, which is what makes 'at or below the reviewed reason count' the end state rather than zero

class_c_claim_evidence_containers.amendment: umbrella criterion 7, Amendment A (2026-08-12): Phase 1's authored claim-evidence corpus and _REVIEW_ISSUE_REFS are Class C, not claim prose; counter 2 is measured net of them

calculator/item_coverage.py._ATTACKER_STATE_HOMES: the attacker lane's authored claims: where a modelled state actually comes from, resolved against the symbol it names
calculator/item_coverage.py._DUAL_SIDED_MECHANICS: the evidence member naming the mechanic a dual-sided claim's two halves belong to, and the handshake policy its packet declares, both resolved against the pairing registry
calculator/item_coverage.py._ISSUE_REF_ONLY_ITEMS: the two items whose only claim carrier is their tracked review, authored so the ref rides a claim instead of being published by nothing
calculator/item_coverage.py._REVIEW_ISSUE_REFS: criterion 14's own blessed survivor: tracked review issues per item, routed onto a claim at import.  An issue reference states no coverage, so it is not the prose counter 2 is named for
calculator/item_coverage.py._SOURCE_REFS: the wiki revision each claim's evidence was read from; a claim with no source is the sentence this phase deletes, so the table is mandated rather than retirable
calculator/item_coverage.py._SUPPORT_PACKET_CLAIMS: the support-packet lane's authored claims, each quoting the packet source the totality check reads back
calculator/item_coverage.py._TARGET_CERTIFIED_IMPLS: the target lane's certified half, same shape and same resolution
calculator/item_coverage.py._TARGET_MODELED_IMPLS: the target lane's authored claims, each naming the implementation the resolver resolves it against
calculator/item_coverage.py._UTILITY_HOMES: the utility lane's authored evidence: the module and symbol a utility outcome is delivered by

modules.calculator/item_effects.py: the number registries themselves — ITEM_EFFECTS, ALLY_ITEM_EFFECTS and the static effect tables. An item name is the key of the home this phase reads through
modules.calculator/item_outcomes.py: the reviewed outcome-dimension declaration and nothing else — one mapping, no function, no branch, asserted by tests/test_item_outcomes.py.  Twenty of its items compile to no rule at all, so what an item changes about a fight besides the damage number is a product fact whose key is the item it is about
modules.calculator/item_source.py: availability from the cached source data; the name is the identity of the row being decided, per CLAUDE.md rule 6
modules.calculator/loadout_rules.py: build legality — uniques, boots and slot rules keyed by the item they constrain
modules.calculator/passive_parser.py: the wiki-text parser's per-item parse configuration; the names decide how a page is read, not how a fight is priced
modules.calculator/role_quests.py: quest-item declarations keyed by the item that carries the quest
modules.calculator/trigger_stream.py: Phase 2's capability registry: `ItemOwner("…")` declares who owns a mechanic, which is the same kind of home as the number registry. **Not in the prior**: the module did not exist when the prior counts were taken, and its 38 sites are the whole Class C divergence

modules.app.py: one `kind="Boots"` stat-category label that collides with the item literally named Boots — a name match, not a dispatch
modules.calculator/champions/janna.py: an ability display-name default (`Zephyr` is Janna's W) that collides with an item name
modules.calculator/champions/viego.py: an ability display-name default (Viego's R is named after the item he steals) that collides with an item name
modules.calculator/rotation_resolver.py: three sample builds in the rotation certification matrix; they name builds to certify orders over and dispatch no behaviour
modules.calculator/scenario.py: the same `kind="Boots"` stat-category label on the request-parsing side
modules.calculator/shield_ledger.py: the shield-source label `Lifeline`, which names a mechanic class and collides with an item name

targets.rule: a target's gap may not grow, a met target may not stay recorded outstanding, and a target the receipt has lost is a failure; the block records targets and never amends one.  Counter 4's lane targets are measured net of the committed deferral rows (Amendment B), and the gross and deferred halves ride the entry so the netting is checkable arithmetic
